answers.q1: Cargo (Rust, edition 2024, MSRV 1.96). There is no separate install step. Run `cargo build` from the repo root and it fetches and builds dependencies. To fetch only, run `cargo fetch`.
answers.q2: cargo test --all (the command documented in AGENTS.md and the README). CI runs `cargo test --verbose --workspace --features unstable-index` and `cargo test --verbose --workspace --features pcre2`.
answers.q3: cargo test --test integration regression::. The integration tests build as the single target `integration` from tests/tests.rs (autotests = false), and tests/regression.rs is the `regression` module in it, so `--test regression` would not work.
answers.q4: cargo fmt --all --check (rustfmt.toml: max_width 79). CI also runs the docs check: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace. The zsh completion check is `ci/test-complete`, which needs a built `rg` and zsh. CI has no clippy step.
answers.q5: No vendored directories. `target/` is build output and is gitignored. `Cargo.lock` is managed by cargo, so don't hand-edit it. The man page, shell completions and `--help` text are generated at build time from the flag docs in crates/core/flags/defs.rs, so edit that file and not the generated output. I did not check whether `HomebrewFormula` is a symlink to `pkg/brew`, so treat it as probably not hand-edited.
